title: When does limestone decompose?
caption: For CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂, ΔH = +178 kJ mol⁻¹ and ΔS = +161 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹. ΔG = ΔH − TΔS falls as T rises and becomes negative above T = ΔH ÷ ΔS = 1106 K (about 833 °C): the reaction becomes feasible.
alt: ΔG against temperature: a straight line falling from +178 kJ/mol at 0 K, crossing zero near 1106 K.
description: At 0 K, ΔG = ΔH = +178 kJ mol⁻¹.
It crosses zero at 1106 K: above this ΔG is negative.
